- Next step: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan) with your engineering and SRE teams.

- Tue 30 Mar, 10:00-11:00 PDT

Attached is a draft trial plan & success-criteria spreadsheet so you can review before the call. Please let me know which slot works or suggest two alternatives and we’ll send invites.

Thanks,
